Movie-App — browse, discover, shuffle

Mockup v3 · every value is real or explicitly blank — nothing is invented
Real: title, year, runtime, genres, director and IMDb score come from IMDb's official datasets. Your ratings and posters come from your export and RSS feed.
Blank (—): Rotten Tomatoes everywhere — needs an OMDb key. Posters exist only for the ~50 films in the RSS window; the rest need TMDB.
Matched: 167 of your 170 watched films resolved against IMDb; the rest show — because no confident title+year match exists.
